name: HYALURONATE/OXYMETAZOLINE 2MG/0.25MG OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 10ML
description: Sodium hyaluronate ophthalmic solution is used as a lubricant to relieve the symptoms of dry eye. The concentration of 4 mg/ml (or 0.4%) is one of the highest available on the market for artificial tears, helping to provide longer-lasting lubrication and relief for moderate to severe cases of dry eye. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
